The formula for the derivative of arctangent is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arctan}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2{x}^{3}+x)] \\  & =\frac{1}{1+{(2{x}^{3}+x)}^{2}}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2{x}^{3}+x) \\  & =\frac{1}{1+(2{x}^{3}+x)^{2}}\cdot (6{x}^{2}+1) \\  & =\frac{6{x}^{2}+1}{1+(2{x}^{3}+x)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
